page_title: TOU 1-2 LYO | Toulouse v Lyon 29/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' The match has just finished.
90+5' 1 - 2 Goal! Malick Fofana (Lyon) gathered the ball off a rebound inside the box and fired home into the bottom right corner.
90+3' Here is a change. Yann Gboho is going off and Carles Martinez gives the last tactical orders to Miha Zajc (Toulouse).
90+3' Substitution. Denis Genreau (Toulouse) on for Vincent Sierro.
90' There will be a minimum of 9 min. of added time.
89' It will be a substitution. Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) is ready to enter the pitch as Sael Kumbedi walks off.
87' Gael Angoula shows a yellow card to Cristian Casseres (Toulouse), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.

85' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
79' Lucas Perri (Lyon) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
76' Lucas Perri (Lyon) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

72' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Lucas Perri makes a decent save to deny his effort directed to the middle of the target.
69' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Gael Angoula who sees an offensive foul.
67' Substitution. Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) has come on for Georges Mikautadze.
67' Pierre Sage decides to make a substitution. Tanner Tessmann will be replaced by Corentin Tolisso (Lyon).
67' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Gabriel Suazo.
65' Carles Martinez has decided to substitute Shavy Babicka and he is replaced by Joshua King (Toulouse).
64' The substitution is prepared. Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Frank Magri.
61' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
58' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
57' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
57' Lyon have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The ball is out of play. Lyon will have a chance to score from a corner.
56' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play. Lyon are awarded a corner kick.
55' Frank Magri (Toulouse) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
54' Frank Magri (Toulouse) picks up an injury.
53' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jordan Veretout trots off the pitch and is replaced by Rayan Cherki (Lyon).
53' Pierre Sage has decided to make a change. Malick Fofana (Lyon) replaces Wilfried Zaha.
49' Lucas Perri makes a brilliant save! Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper into the middle of the goal.

48' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
48' A yellow card for a tackle by Duje Caleta-Car (Lyon). Gael Angoula doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' Gael Angoula blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Clinton Mata (Lyon) commits a foul and Gael Angoula immediately signals a free kick.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
40' The corner is swung in and Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) leaps above the defence only to send his header a whisker over the bar from close in.
40' Said Benrahma (Lyon) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
40' Abner (Lyon) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. It will be a corner kick for Lyon.
39' The resulting set piece from Lyon is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
39' An attempted cross from Said Benrahma (Lyon) is cleared. Lyon will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
36' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.

35' Frank Magri (Toulouse) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse have been awarded a corner kick.
28' 1 - 1 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it inside the bottom left corner of his own goal.
24' Gael Angoula blows his whistle and it's Wilfried Zaha (Lyon) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
16' Flag goes up against Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
14' 1 - 0 Fantastic team goal! Yann Gboho (Toulouse) was set free in the area by Vincent Sierro and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the top left corner. 1:0.
10' Gael Angoula shows a yellow card to Jordan Veretout (Lyon) for a tough tackle.
9' What an opportunity! Frank Magri (Toulouse) wins the ball from the resulting set piece and unleashes a precise shot from inside the goal area which sails narrowly wide of the left post!
8' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
8' Gael Angoula blows his whistle and signals a foul after Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) brought his opponent down. Toulouse have a free kick.
6' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post.
4' Wilfried Zaha (Lyon) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Lyon will have the kick-off.
Gael Angoula got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
